description: This file defines the SugarRegistry class, which implements a singleton pattern for managing a global registry of data in the SuiteCRM project. It provides methods for accessing, setting, checking, unsetting data, and adding data to global variables.

classes.name: SugarRegistry
classes.description: A singleton class that manages a global registry of data, allowing storage and retrieval of key-value pairs across the application's scope.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method for the SugarRegistry class. It is empty and doesn't perform any initialization.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static method that returns the singleton instance of SugarRegistry associated with the specified name. Creates a new instance if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to retrieve a value by key from the internal data array.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Magic method to set a value by key in the internal data array.

methods.name: __isset
methods.description: Magic method to check if a key exists in the internal data array.

methods.name: __unset
methods.description: Magic method to remove a key and its associated value from the internal data array.

methods.name: addToGlobals
methods.description: Copies all key-value pairs from the internal data array to the PHP global variables.
